🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION, Value/Cyclical style. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; cyclical sectors (Energy, Materials, Utilities, Real Estate) are among the seven positives while Technology and Financials are weakest, and Top 5 performers are broad across five sectors — supports a rotation view.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities leading: CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND and sector 1W +3.11% (10 stocks). Communication strong via NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND and Materials showing strength via FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is lagging: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND; Financials are weak: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND; Consumer Discretionary also softer (TSLA 1W: -2.26% | 1M: -6.71% BELOW TREND).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY; INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY; NEM (1W: +6.44% | 1M: -1.48%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5), which supports rotation into cyclicals and select defensives.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND; COF (1W: -6.13% | 1M: -10.08%) BELOW TREND; IBM (1W: -6.59% | 1M: -17.87%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND; GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Financials and parts of Tech—watch banking names for spillover risk.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY, INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY, NEM (1W: +6.44% | 1M: -1.48%) RECOVERY. Note divergences: PYPL and INTU show strong 1W bounces while 1M remains negative and both carry bearish recent headlines—tactical, not broad confirmation.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is under pressure with 1W -0.72% and many large names BELOW TREND: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -7.22%) BELOW TREND; pockets of short-term bounces (INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY, CRM (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY) but sector tone remains corrective.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are lagging with 1W -3.49% and broad weakness among banks and card issuers: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND; PYPL is a notable RECOVERY within the group but headline risk is elevated.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing resilience: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.13% | 1M: -0.26%) RECOVERY — sector is one of the seven positives and acting as a defensive/cycling sleeve.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclical/value exposure within the current rotation: XOM (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +11.58%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +10.98%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to large-cap techs under stress (NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL BELOW TREND) and monitor banking names showing concentrated weakness. Style: Value/Cyclical over Growth given breadth and leadership.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through would confirm rotation. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY — watch news-price divergence on PYPL.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities, Energy, Materials (all positive this week and part of rotation). BEARISH: Technology and Financials (both clear 1W underperformance and key to broader market tone).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim the recent 1M trading range would deepen downside risk. AAPL (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION — hold of the near-term support zone would keep constructive entries for patient positions. JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND — a decisive recovery above the prior 1M pivot would signal stabilization for banks.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+70): Eli Lilly GLP‑1/Olumiant update; price confirming — LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment and price aligned. FCX (+80): Grasberg operating rights extension; FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirmed and supporting materials strength.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (-75): FSD safety concerns; TSLA (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND — headline and price aligned, elevated event risk. PYPL (-55): Lawsuits and CEO change; PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY — news is bearish while 1W bounce creates divergence, monitor for follow-through. INTU (-50): price target cut; INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY — news negative vs short-term bounce signals tactical uncertainty.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, Value/Cyclical style with Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND and cyclicals like FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +3.54% | 1M: +11.58%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Major divergence to monitor: large-cap Tech and key Financials (NVDA, MSFT, GS BELOW TREND) versus short-term bounces in names like PYPL and INTU — watch news-price confirmation.
